tokens.name: app-primary
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, active states, focus-ring accent. 4.48:1 on app-surface, just under AA for small text (inherited from the source); use it for 16px+ semibold button labels and links only, never for body copy.

tokens.name: app-primary-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover fill of primary buttons; high-emphasis text on app-surface (6.2:1) and on app-primary-tint (4.55:1).

tokens.name: app-primary-deep
tokens.usage: Headings on app-primary-tint (7.8:1) and on app-surface (10.6:1); first-anchor chart colour.

tokens.name: app-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary chart series and icons on app-surface (3.9:1, fine for marks, not for text).

tokens.name: app-primary-tint
tokens.usage: Selected rows, badges, subtle fills. Text on it: app-primary-deep, app-text, app-text-muted or app-ink.

tokens.name: app-surface
tokens.usage: Page and card background; also the label colour on app-primary and app-primary-strong buttons.

tokens.name: app-text
tokens.usage: Body copy on app-surface (11.4:1) and app-primary-tint (8.4:1).

tokens.name: app-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and card supporting text on app-surface (6.6:1) and app-primary-tint (4.9:1).

tokens.name: app-text-subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers and tertiary text on app-surface only (5.0:1). Below 4.5:1 on app-primary-tint, so do not put it there.

tokens.name: app-ink
tokens.usage: Card headings and the focus outline on app-surface.

tokens.name: app-border
tokens.usage: 1px borders on cards and dividers on app-surface. Decorative only at 1.17:1; it does not meet 3:1 as an input boundary, so inputs rely on the label and the 2px focus state.

tokens.name: app-link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover colour on app-surface (7.3:1).

tokens.name: app-danger
tokens.usage: Decided, not extracted: Bootstrap's default danger. Error text on app-surface (4.5:1); always pair with an icon and a message. Success and warning are not yet decided.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing-style hero only; use h1 below the md breakpoint. Source uses Flama (commercial); Nunito Sans 600 is the decided fallback.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Top level on app screens, one per view.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy in app-text. Keep lines under 80 characters.
styles.sample: Your balance updates when a payment clears.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, 16 to 18px; height comes from padding.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions and helper text in app-text-muted.

spacing.note: 8px base unit. Scale from the source; the names are decided. Avoid the odd values the extraction found (6.5, 8.5, 14.5px). Matches Bootstrap's default spacers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Compact component padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap, label-to-field spacing.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between cards and groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large section and hero spacing.

radius.note: Radius follows hierarchy: bigger containers get bigger radius. Never one radius for everything.

tokens.name: app-radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, tags, inline links with backgrounds.

tokens.name: app-radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dropdowns, inputs.

tokens.name: app-radius-lg
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, feature cards.

tokens.name: app-radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons and chips.

tokens.name: app-radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, large inputs, hero containers.

shadow.note: One shadow only, for floating layers. Static cards use the app-border outline or a flat tint.

tokens.name: app-shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers and the map info card. Not on static cards.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Container max width (12-column Bootstrap grid).

tokens.name: container-gutter
tokens.usage: Container side padding, measured on the source site.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: touch-target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum size of any interactive target.

breakpoint.note: Bootstrap's standard set, mobile-first; design at 360px wide first.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Min width for sm.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Min width for md; display drops to h1 below it.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Min width for lg.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Min width for xl.

tokens.name: bp-xxl
tokens.usage: Min width for xxl.
